vision.verse1: "See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it?
vision.verse2: I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland."

invitation.label: An Invitation to Global Leaders
invitation.opening:
We stand at the most critical crossroads in history.
Artificial intelligence is reshaping the course of civilization — surpassing any revolution that came before.
invitation.questionIntro: Yet the most critical question for humanity remains not:
invitation.rightQuestion: "Do humans still remember the purpose for which God created us?"
techLimits: Technology can expand human capabilities, but it cannot create love.
Technology can generate information, but it cannot generate wisdom.
Technology can connect the world, but it cannot heal the human heart.
manifesto: Technology may change the speed of the world, but only Truth determines its direction.
AI can expand human capability, but it can never replace human dignity or divine destiny.
The greatest crisis of the future is not that AI becomes too powerful — it is that humanity loses heaven's wisdom.
invitation.inviteText: We sincerely invite pastors, innovators, educators, business leaders, media pioneers, and next-generation influencers to join this historic gathering.
invitation.closing:
The future does not belong to machines —
but to leaders who carry wisdom, character, courage, and the love of Christ.
invitation.verse: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you."

detail.heading: About 2026 International Summit
detail.intro:
We firmly believe that 2026 will be a year of alignment for Asian churches and workplace leaders.
God is calling His elite soldiers, whether at the forefront of the digital wave, or those guarding the 7 mountains of influence, to rise and shine, and win the cultural mountaintops for Him.

points.title: Spiritual Convergence
points.desc: The 2026 Impact Asia Alliance Summit is about to take place. We see that God's glorious plan has been set in motion. This is not just a gathering, but a feast preparing for the future of God's Kingdom.

points.title: Critical Turning Point
points.desc: As AI reshapes the world, we are standing at the most critical turning point of human civilization. In October 2026, the IAA Summit will start a divine conversation in Phoenix, Arizona.

points.title: Role of Stewardship
points.desc: In the future AI era, how humans can return to the role of "steward," finding a way of coexistence between technology and the soul. This is more than just a grand gathering of digital intelligence, lifestyle aesthetics, and Christian faith.

points.title: Rebirth in the Wilderness
points.desc: It is a rebirth of thought in a vast desert landscape. We warmly invite you to join leaders from around the world, to a gathering to promote peace, wisdom, and love for the future world.

points.title: Vision & Commitment
points.desc: The church needs to enter society and make global impact. Let's stand in the gap together, become vessels to receive new wine, witness the union of North American and Asia-Pacific churches and God's miraculous works of opening rivers in the desert and making roads in the wilderness!
